recipes.label: The Revelation of Sensation
recipes.startdescription: 'Very well,' Sulochana says, 'I have a role for you. This is a one-time performance.' She takes a thoughtful drag on her cigarette. 'You'll be immersing your senses,' she says. 'Discovering the thrill of the unseen.'
recipes.description: I am assigned a private space of my own - intimate and dimly lit - where I can indulge in the experience. Sulochana hands me a box of unique and tactile materials. As I touch the first item, a rush of sensations wash over me. The world seems more vibrant, more alive.

recipes.label: The Unfolding of Power
recipes.startdescription: 'Very well,' Sulochana says, 'I have a task for you. This is a singular undertaking.' She takes a purposeful drag on her cigarette. 'You'll be embracing your power,' she informs me. Her gaze is unyielding. 'Unveiling your potential.'
recipes.description: I am assigned a secluded space of my own - a room with energy pulsating in its corners. Here, Sulochana guides me towards my first act of dominion. As I make my first assertive gesture, I feel a surge of power. I am no longer the same.

recipes.label: The Dance of Enlightenment
recipes.startdescription: 'Very well,' Sulochana says, 'I have a dance for you. This is a unique rhythm.' She takes a slow drag on her cigarette. 'You'll be finding enlightenment through movement,' she explains. 'Your spirit will be freed.'
recipes.description: I am assigned a personal dance studio of my own - filled with the rhythm of the universe. Sulochana guides me towards my first dance of awakening. As I move, I feel an energy flowing within me. I am transcending.

recipes.label: The Cat's Path
recipes.startdescription: 'Very well,' Sulochana says, 'I have a journey for you. This is a one-of-a-kind adventure.' She takes a playful drag on her cigarette. 'You'll be walking the Cat's Path,' she tells me. 'Discovering the unity in all things.'
recipes.description: I am assigned a cozy space of my own - filled with the purrs of invisible cats. Sulochana introduces me to my first guide - a spectral feline. As I follow the cat's path, I feel a connection with the universe. I am one.
